     Corn-smut. Fungi.

     A fungus found growing on Indian corn.

     The tincture is prepared from the fresh ripe fungus.

     Introduced and proved by Burt, see Monograph ; proved by Hoyne, Trans. Am. I. Hom., 1872, p. 493.
